I'm not really sure what to say...
In any case, I owe you my thanks.

rows.label: tlk70000035_05_msg0002
rows.name:
He may be a loud, hopeless idiot, but
Leon is an important partner to me.

rows.label: tlk70000035_05_msg0003
rows.name:
This whole ordeal made me realize that
simple, important truth all too well.

rows.label: tlk70000035_05_msg0004
rows.name:
But I never thought Sarah would give
in. How am I supposed to face her now?

rows.label: tlk70000035_05_msg0005

I'd better not accidentally tell her
Leon has lovers all over the place...
